gamma_eq33_vs_numerical.note: central difference at step 1e-3 in ln P; its truncation error is gamma_fd_step_error

gamma_gap_over_budget.note: gap over the difference's truncation plus round-off error, pointwise; where truncation dominates the gap is the Richardson estimate itself, so the ratio is 1 + O(dlnP^2) there

gamma_fd_step_error.note: second-order truncation error of the central difference, from two step sizes

gamma_single_site_collapse.note: eq. (33) with one site is eq. (16)

karger_z_halved_halfunits.note: the deviation over half a unit of the printed last digit (the source's own precision)

karger_gap_over_rounding.note: the two printed averages differ by far more than their rounding

karger_resistance_identity.note: c^2/D_z = a^2/D_x + b^2/D_y, satisfied by the corrected eq. (23c)

dsl_3MP_halfunits_max.note: the deviation over half a unit of the printed last digit (the source's own precision)

extrema_max_offset_rel.note: the criterion for a maximum 'at Theta_sat,A': within 2 % of Theta_sat

extrema_2MP_slip_shift.note: 'moves nothing': below 0.01 % of the extremum's loading

gamma_identity_slips_max.note: the identity on every slipped row stays at the central-difference error: blind to parameters

swing_reciprocal_gap.note: 1/(1-theta) times (1-theta) is one: no row can move it

sh75_production_rel_err.note: production Sh at F = 0.75 against its step and cell extrapolation, both curves

flux_ratio_over_rounding.note: deviation over the relative rounding allowance of the two two-figure fluxes

delta_spread_identity.note: the two thicknesses' ratio is the flux ratio's deviation, algebraically

space_observed_order.note: constant D, finest triple, cell size

dt_observed_order.note: constant D, finest triple, backward Euler

space_ladder_over_roundoff.note: finest successive difference over the accumulated LU round-off bound

dt_ladder_over_roundoff.note: finest successive difference over the accumulated LU round-off bound

space_refined_rel_err.note: step extrapolation on the finest grid: the spatial error of that grid; its value depends on the extrapolation order (8.5e-6 with the observed order, 1.2e-5 with order 1)

ext_both_vs_series.note: extrapolated in both axes against eq. (30): the remainder of a first-order extrapolation whose step orders are 0.98 and 0.99, against a production error of 1.5e-3

nl_space_order.note: 3MP desorption, finest triple, cell size; the ladder approaches 2 from below

nl_space_over_roundoff.note: finest successive difference over the Newton tolerance accumulated over the steps

nl_time_over_roundoff.note: finest successive difference over the Newton tolerance accumulated over the steps

nl_production_err.note: production discretisation error of the hardest non-linear uptake; an order below every uptake difference the page reads off

face_mean_shift.note: of the order of the production discretisation error: no result depends on the face mean

centre_bc_shift.note: the r = 0 face has zero area in a sphere

sh_asymptote_dev.note: one-mode limit at Fo = 2; m >= 2 terms are e^-59

series_tail_max.note: tail bound of eq. (30) at the smallest Fo used

j15_tau_gap.note: the same root on J1.5, committed on another machine

j15_uptake_gap.note: the same uptake on J1.5, committed on another machine

sh75_weak_rises_with_theta_s.note: steps theta_s 0.3 -> 0.6 -> 0.9, of 2, where Sh at F = 0.75 rises

mp3_desorption_rate_rises.note: backward-Euler steps of the 3MP desorption, both scenarios, where the rate rises
